name: Technical Debt

title: 'refactor: [Short description of tech debt]'

---

**Technical Debt Description**
Explain what code or configuration requires refactoring, cleaning, or updating.

**Impact of Debt**
Why is this technical debt? How does it affect performance, maintenance, or scaling?

**Proposed Remediation**
How do you plan to fix this debt? What components or layers are affected?
